interaction: A CSS-built adding machine: type or tap an amount, choose + GST (add 10%) or − GST (take out 1/11) and press Print — a paper tape strikes out amount, GST and total line by line, keeps the last five calculations and can be torn off; a mechanical-counter countdown circles the next quarterly BAS due date for self-lodgers.
notes: Calculator figures are illustrative and rounded to the cent; BAS dates are the standard quarterly self-lodger dates computed from the visitor's clock (agent lodgement program dates are not modelled). Enquiry form is demo-only.
